MY LITTLE PET · TEJA PRIYAN

About My Little Pet

My Little Pet is a cozy virtual-pet game made by Teja Priyan, an independent developer in India. Name your little friend, feed them, decorate their room and enjoy short games together.

Made for little breaks

The original Free edition is a simple Windows companion. Plus adds a bigger pet family, playful toys, decorations and activities. Both editions and the mobile room are free.

The Windows pet can wander over your desktop. The phone version is an installable web app with its own pet room. Progress is stored locally and does not automatically sync between devices.

Questions or bug reports: teja1616150@gmail.com.
